commandCases.name: packed-extraction
command:
import pathlib,tarfile
p=pathlib.Path("/tmp/capirov2-cleanup-meri-local-dispatch-conversion/docs/shared-newsletter-receiving-packed-distribution-20261013/qualified-37d574a3/artifact/capiro-shared-0.0.0.tgz")
root=pathlib.Path("/workspace/capiro-shared-newsletter-receiving-dist-37d574a3-20261013/consumer-attempt-1/node_modules/@capiro/shared")
with tarfile.open(p,'r:gz') as t:
 for m in t.getmembers():
  q=pathlib.PurePosixPath(m.name)
  assert m.isfile() and q.parts[0]=='package' and '..' not in q.parts and not q.is_absolute()
  out=root.joinpath(*q.parts[1:]); out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
  assert not out.exists()
  out.write_bytes(t.extractfile(m).read())
print('All regular package entries extracted without symlink, path traversal, install or lifecycle.')
